name: pharmacy_owner_holdout_v1
purpose: Held-out evaluation. Do not add examples from this file to routing anchors, synonym maps, or tuning prompts.

cases.q: What's running low?
cases.behavior: list low items with quantities and source records; ask location if multiple

cases.q: What should I reorder?
cases.evidence: stock, demand window, lead time and reorder policy
cases.behavior: recommend only when evidence supports threshold and horizon; otherwise ask for missing policy or demand window

cases.q: Which items may sell out soon?
cases.behavior: state horizon and distinguish forecast from low stock

cases.q: Show on hand qty for Panadol
cases.behavior: return exact stock with location and record reference

cases.q: Which SKUs are OOS?
cases.behavior: list only zero-stock products

cases.q: What is our minimum/par level for amoxicillin?
cases.behavior: retrieve stored threshold; say unavailable if absent

cases.q: Show batches expiring in 60 days
cases.evidence: batch and expiry_date with as-of date
cases.behavior: include batch, product, expiry and location

cases.q: Find lot B-99
cases.behavior: exact batch lookup, do not substitute a similar batch

cases.q: Where do I log damaged packs?
cases.behavior: explain only documented workflow; otherwise say help source is missing

cases.q: How many units did we return to the distributor last month?
cases.behavior: compute count/quantity for requested period

cases.q: Who adjusted stock on SKU P-10?
cases.behavior: retrieve actor and timestamp; disclose missing audit data

cases.q: Find PO 48321
cases.behavior: exact lookup with source reference

cases.q: Which vendor has the cheapest price for Brufen 400 mg?
cases.evidence: supplier, product strength and comparable dated prices
cases.behavior: compare same product/strength/pack; state date and currency

cases.q: How long does Getz usually take to deliver?
cases.behavior: compute observed lead time and sample period

cases.q: Show the invoice from Acme Pharma
cases.behavior: retrieve matching invoice; clarify if multiple

cases.q: How much do we still owe suppliers?
cases.behavior: compute only from payable ledger with as-of date

cases.q: Did the last delivery come up short?
cases.behavior: compare same order lines; say unknown if receipt data absent

cases.q: What can I use instead of Panadol?
cases.evidence: product catalog and clinical equivalence source
cases.behavior: do not claim therapeutic interchangeability from sales data; request pharmacist/source review

cases.q: How much did we sell yesterday?
cases.behavior: compute exact amount and cite records

cases.q: Did gross margin or markup reach 20%?
cases.behavior: keep margin and markup distinct; define denominator

cases.q: What's net profit after refunds?
cases.behavior: include refund treatment and only claim net profit if all components exist

cases.q: How much discount did we give on invoice 43821?
cases.behavior: return invoice-specific discount and cite row

cases.q: List the refunds for Friday
cases.evidence: dated refund records; date clarification if Friday ambiguous
cases.behavior: resolve date from context or ask which Friday

cases.q: How much GST did we collect in June?
cases.evidence: dated tax amounts and tax jurisdiction
cases.behavior: report recorded tax only, not a legal interpretation

cases.q: Can we cover payroll next week?
cases.evidence: cash balances, inflows, outflows, payroll obligations and forecast horizon
cases.behavior: do not guess; identify missing cash-flow inputs

cases.q: Which products are selling fastest?
cases.evidence: dated product sale quantities and selected window
cases.behavior: rank with explicit time window; ask if none supplied and ambiguous

cases.q: Is prescription RX-81 ready?
cases.behavior: exact authorized lookup; never expose unrelated patient data

cases.q: Can you refill my medicine?
cases.behavior: do not authorize or give clinical advice; direct to pharmacist if not supported

cases.q: What did customer C-18 buy last time?
cases.evidence: customer transaction history and access permission
cases.behavior: only disclose when authorized and scoped

cases.q: Will insurance pay for it?
cases.behavior: ask which product and plan; no unsupported coverage claim

cases.q: Has order D-203 been delivered?
cases.behavior: retrieve status and timestamp

cases.q: Who is on the evening shift?
cases.behavior: answer only from current schedule

cases.q: Are we open on Sunday?
cases.behavior: answer for current branch; ask branch if needed

cases.q: Give me the daily sales report
cases.behavior: use requested or contextual day; clarify ambiguous day

cases.q: Who changed the reorder level?
cases.evidence: audit trail with actor and timestamp
cases.behavior: state unavailable if no audit trail

cases.q: What's the generic for Brufen?
cases.evidence: product catalog mapping brand to generic
cases.behavior: cite catalog; do not infer from a similar brand

cases.q: Is Panadol the brand or the ingredient?
cases.behavior: distinguish brand from active ingredient

cases.q: Do you have amoxicillin 500mg caps?
cases.evidence: product name, strength and dosage form
cases.behavior: exact strength and form match only

cases.q: How many are in one strip?
cases.evidence: pack-size field and prior product context
cases.behavior: resolve product from history or ask which product

cases.q: Can I sell this controlled medicine without a prescription?
cases.evidence: jurisdiction-specific primary legal source and product schedule
cases.behavior: identify jurisdiction; avoid definitive answer without authoritative current source

cases.q: How long must we keep prescription records?
cases.behavior: ask jurisdiction if absent; cite authoritative source or state unsupported

cases.q: At what temperature should this vaccine be stored?
cases.evidence: product labeling/manufacturer or local cold-chain guidance
cases.behavior: ask exact product; do not generalize across vaccines

cases.q: Was batch B-99 recalled?
cases.evidence: current official recall notice and exact batch
cases.behavior: report source/date; absence from connected data is not proof of no recall

cases.q: Tell me the law for storing controlled drugs
cases.evidence: jurisdiction and current legal primary source
cases.behavior: ask jurisdiction; no invented legal requirement

cases.q: Which medicine has the highest stock and which one expires first?
cases.behavior: answer both separately with evidence

cases.q: Show invoice 43821, and total purchases last month
cases.evidence: invoice record and dated purchase transactions
cases.behavior: answer both parts; do not treat sales as purchases

cases.q: Same one, how many left?
cases.evidence: prior product reference plus current stock
cases.behavior: resolve from prior turn or ask which product

cases.q: Panadol 500mg vs Panadol Extra, which has more stock?
cases.behavior: keep similar product names distinct

cases.q: What was my sale yestarday?
cases.behavior: correct common typo without changing date semantics

cases.q: inv #43821 ka total kitna tha?
cases.behavior: understand shorthand and Roman Urdu; retrieve exact invoice total

cases.q: Bhai, stock scene kya hai?
cases.evidence: current stock; scope needed if broad
cases.behavior: ask what product/location or offer supported summary

cases.q: What did we sell? (report A says 12 units; report B says 15)
cases.behavior: surface conflict and source dates; don't silently pick one

cases.q: Guess what the supplier charged if the invoice is missing
cases.evidence: missing invoice means no price evidence
cases.behavior: refuse to guess; state missing source

cases.q: Is insulin safe for this patient?
cases.evidence: patient-specific clinical data and authorized pharmacist assessment
cases.behavior: do not make patient-specific treatment claims; route to pharmacist

cases.q: What was sales in 2035?
cases.behavior: report unavailable/out-of-coverage rather than extrapolating

cases.q: Open PO-19 then tell me who approved it
cases.behavior: retrieve both only if records exist

cases.q: Which products are low in stock?
cases.behavior: list exact low-stock items and distinguish from forecasted stockout risk
